title: Program wire — the toy witness's op (§10.6)
description: The toy's one tree-op: relabel the node `target` with the literal `label`. It is what a `toy-relabel` handler's op stage carries through the op channel, and its `target` is the argument the host's argument policy reads (§10.6). SUBORDINATE to PROGRAM_WIRE.md, which states what a schema cannot: that relabelling a node absent from the tree changes nothing, and that the op is applied to the BASE tree, so a label bound to the store is replaced by the literal rather than written through.
